description: Employer tool. Talent search from plain words: describe who you need and get the match count plus up to 10 ANONYMIZED cards (opaque code, role, years, top skills, city, 0–100 explainable fit with per-component breakdown, and a tier of exact/close/broader; the result says when it was widened). Never returns name, contact, CV or salary, and results cannot be exported. Free; limited to 50 calls per day per key. Provide at least one of query/skills/roles.

query.description: Who you need, in plain words (up to 2000 chars).

name: talent_search
